meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把访谈或播客视频叠加动态字卡与图文框,直接产出可发布成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段访谈或播客录像,想快速加上设计好的动态字卡和图文框再发布。
copy.tagline_en: Overlay timed graphic cards and lower-thirds on your podcast or interview video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an interview video needing timed graphic overlays before publishing.

howto.what: 给现成的口播/访谈/播客视频叠上按时间设计的图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用等,与转录时间轴同步,可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 画布,原片完整播放,最后渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”等关键词,或要求给视频做图形包装时触发;纯字幕归 embedded-captions,意图不清先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这段访谈视频用图形卡片包装一下
say.note: 先确认用哪段片子,再逐张设计卡片

say.text: 给我这条口播视频加标题卡和数据标注
say.note: 卡片内容与时间点从转录里生成

say.text: 输出 9:16 竖版,卡片跟着字幕走
say.note: 画布比例和卡片时点按转录对齐

howto.what_en: Layers timed, designed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts — onto an existing talking-head/interview/podcast clip, synced to its transcript, on a 16:9/9:16/4:5 canvas; the clip plays untouched, rendered to MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or "package / dress up my video"; plain subtitles go to embedded-captions, and anything unclear goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Package this interview clip with graphic cards
say_en.note: Confirms which clip, then designs each card

say_en.text: Add title cards and data callouts to my talking-head video
say_en.note: Card content and timings come from the transcript

say_en.text: Make it 9:16 and sync the cards to the transcript
say_en.note: Sets canvas ratio and card timings
